title: An empty side is not filled from the customer at invoicing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-B} as its one sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; its card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" reading "Unassigned" and "Sales Representative - Parts" reading {Sales-rep-A}; it has one labor line and one part.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Invoice {Work-order-1}.
  2. Open Reports > Sales By Representative for today with Show Unassigned on and the Sales Type column on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the invoice is created.
  • Step 2: the labor is credited to Unassigned on a "Labor" row and the part to {Sales-rep-A} on a "Parts" row; nothing is credited to {Sales-rep-B}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives), story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S4-N1: “A work order with a representative on either side does not use the customer's representatives, even for the empty side (S2-N1).”
  • S2-N1: “A side is never refilled on its own. Setting one side to "Unassigned" never hands that side to the other person and never fills it from the customer after the work order is created (S4-R24, S4-R28).”
  • S5-R18: “A side with no representative is credited to Unassigned, which shows when Show Unassigned is on, as today.”
